notes.title: Venomous - Update Patch (version 1.2.5)
notes.content:
New Features:

Double Jump: Players can now perform a double jump for greater mobility.

Triple Jump Unlock: Defeating a boss will now grant the ability to triple jump, allowing for even more vertical movement.

Improvements & Optimizations:

Parkour Enhancements: The environment has been improved for smoother parkour movement and better flow.

Performance & Stability: Optimizations have been made to enhance overall stability and improve performance for a smoother gameplay experience.
